printf 'MODE_HEALTH
'; systemctl get-default; systemctl is-active ssh NetworkManager automagic-fan nvargus-daemon gdm; free -b
printf '
ROS_APT_FILES
'; grep -RlnE 'packages\.ros\.org|repo\.ros2\.org' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
ROS_TRUST_FILES
'; find /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d /usr/share/keyrings /etc/apt/keyrings -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*ros*' -print 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
APT_KEY_FINGERPRINTS
'; apt-key finger 2>/dev/null
printf '
ROS_UNITS
'; systemctl list-unit-files --no-pager | grep -Ei 'ros|dds|fast|cyclone|robot' || true; systemctl cat ros_init.service
printf '
ROS_PROCESSES
'; ps -eo pid,ppid,user,comm,args --width 250 | grep -E '/opt/ros/|ros2 |roscore|rosmaster|roslaunch|_ros2_daemon|component_container|micro_ros_agent|fastdds|cyclonedds' | grep -vE 'grep|bash -c|sudo -S' || true
printf '
ROS_STARTUP_FILES
'; grep -RlnE '/opt/ros/|colcon_ws/.*/setup\.|ros2 (daemon|launch|run)|roslaunch|roscore' /etc/profile /etc/bash.bashrc /etc/profile.d /etc/rc.local /etc/cron.d /etc/crontab /home/jetson/.bashrc /home/jetson/.profile /home/jetson/.bash_profile /home/jetson/.config/autostart /home/jetson/.config/systemd/user /home/jetson/.config/fish /home/jetson/.zshrc 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
ROS_CRONTAB
'; crontab -u jetson -l 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'ros|colcon' || true
printf '
ROS_INSTALL_SIZE
'; du -sh /opt/ros /home/jetson/colcon_ws 2>/dev/null || true
